title: .env parser: export prefix, key validation, inline comments, double/single quote semantics, line numbers

hidden_checks.spec: Rule 1: empty and whitespace-only lines are ignored.
Rule 1: lines whose first non-whitespace character is # are ignored.
Rule 1: text is split on \n and a \r at the end of a line is removed.
Rule 2: whitespace allowed before the key, between key and =, and after =; rule 3 strips surrounding whitespace.
Rule 2: optional `export` followed by at least one space or tab is discarded.
Rule 2: a key may itself start with the letters export (exporter=1 sets exporter).
Rule 2: key must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*.
Rule 2: an invalid key raises DotenvError; rule 7: lineno is the 1-based line number.
Rule 2: a line with no = raises DotenvError.
Rule 3: the raw value is the text after the FIRST =.
Rule 3 examples: A=b # note -> b; A=b#c -> b#c; COLOR=#fff -> #fff; EMPTY= # nothing -> ""; A= -> ""; MSG=hello world -> hello world.
Rule 3: a # immediately following a space OR TAB starts a comment.
Rule 3: comment starts at the first # that follows a space or tab; a # not following whitespace is part of the value.
Rule 3: a # that does not immediately follow a space or tab is part of the value.
Rule 3: only surrounding whitespace is stripped (MSG=hello world -> hello world).
Rule 4: whitespace and # inside double quotes are kept verbatim.
Rule 4: \n -> newline, \t -> tab, \" -> ", \\ -> single backslash.
Rule 4: a backslash followed by any other character is kept unchanged ("\d" -> \d).
Rule 4: value extends to the next " not escaped by a backslash; \\ is a single backslash.
Rule 4: quote detection ignores leading spaces and tabs of the raw value.
Rule 4: the value is the text between the quotes (empty here).
Rule 6: after a closing quote only whitespace, optionally followed by a # comment, may appear.
Rule 4: a missing closing quote raises DotenvError (an escaped \" does not close).
Rule 4: values never span lines; rule 7: lineno of the offending line.
Rule 5: single-quoted content is literal, no escape processing ('a\nb' is a, \, n, b).
Rule 5: value extends to the next single quote and is taken literally.
Rule 6: whitespace then a # comment may follow a closing quote.
Rule 5: a missing closing quote raises DotenvError.
Rule 6: anything other than whitespace/comment after a closing quote raises DotenvError; rule 7 lineno.
Rule 7: when a key appears more than once, the last value wins.
Rule 7: lineno is 1-based, counting blank and comment lines.
Desired behavior: DotenvError is the existing ValueError subclass.
Goal: load_env must keep working (it calls parse_env); override semantics unchanged (non-goal).
